<DOCSTRING>
Manages user data and processes user information based on their age.

This class is responsible for adding users, validating their data, and processing them accordingly. It is used by the user management service to handle user-related operations.

Attributes:
    users (List[User]): List of users managed by this class. It is initialized when the class is instantiated and is modified by the `add_user` method.
</DOCSTRING>
